test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Ministries of India released draft National Air Sports Policy, 2022 (NASP) for public comments?

options.text: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

solution:
The correct answer is __"**Ministry of Civil Aviation**".__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On Wednesday, January 22, the*** Ministry of Civil Aviation*** made a copy of the National Air Sports Policy (NASP) available for public comment.
 
• In addition to guaranteeing compliance with global safety standards, the strategy aims to maximize India's potential for ***air sports***.
 
• By ***2030***, India should rank among the top nations for air sports, according to the policy's aim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Government of India's Minister of Civil Aviation is Union Minister*** Jyotiraditya Scindia***.
 
• The new permanent representative for India at the UN Conference on Disarmament is ***Anupam Ray***.
 
• The next Indian ambassador to Mexico has been named, and he is*** Pankaj Sharma***, a member of the 1991 batch of Indian Foreign Service officers.
 
• Indian diplomat*** Pradeep Kumar Rawat*** was chosen to serve as India's ambassador to China beginning in December 2021.
 
• ***The Foreign Contribution Regulation Act (FCRA)*** registration of NGOs with an expiration date between September 29, 2020, and March 31, 2022, has been extended by the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA).
 
• In New Delhi, ***Sanjay Kumar Singh*** was appointed Secretary of the Ministry of Steel.
